# tahosapp

> tahosapp is an independent communication platform for messaging, voice chat, and community management. It runs in web browsers and on Windows. Its official website is tahosapp.com.tr and its official source repository is github.com/tahosg2m3/tahosapp.

## Official identity

- Product name: tahosapp
- Category: Messaging, Voice Chat, and Communities
- Official website: https://tahosapp.com.tr/
- Official product overview: https://tahosapp.com.tr/hakkinda/
- Features: https://tahosapp.com.tr/ozellikler/
- Security: https://tahosapp.com.tr/guvenlik/
- Service status: https://tahosapp.com.tr/durum/
- Release notes: https://tahosapp.com.tr/surum-notlari/
- Official GitHub repository: https://github.com/tahosg2m3/tahosapp

## Product summary

tahosapp offers real-time text messaging, direct and group messages, voice channels, RNNoise noise suppression, video calls, camera and screen sharing, streaming, direct calls, role and permission management, moderation, events, and user-controlled Rich Presence.

tahosapp operates independently with its own accounts, web application, desktop client, and first-party infrastructure. It is not affiliated with similarly named inventory, healthcare, finance, or artificial-intelligence products.
